title: Sign in
description: Fresh installation of the same existing app opens the email/password and Google sign-in screen. No credentials were entered.
source: Existing Terra NT app; clean iPhone 17e simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Create an account
description: Choose Sign up from sign-in to view email, password and password-confirmation fields. No account was created.
source: Existing Terra NT app; clean iPhone 17e simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Password reset requires an email
description: Tap Reset it with an empty email field to show inline guidance. No reset email was sent and no password was changed.
source: Existing Terra NT app; clean iPhone 17e simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Explore — overview
description: Open the Explore tab. Browse Northern Territory destinations on the light basemap before selecting a place.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Explore — place selected
description: Tap Darwin Waterfront. The selected marker opens a place card with the existing seeded rating, tag, description and Navigate action; the rating is not a live review lookup.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Explore — search result
description: Enter Uluru in Search the Territory. A single match is selected and shown with its existing place card; the keyboard remains visible.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Explore — no matching places
description: Enter an unmatched search term. The app displays the no-results message and Clear search recovery action.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Plan AI — before creating a route
description: Open Plan AI with no active session route. Choose Plan My Route to start the questionnaire or open an existing saved route.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Step 1 — age range
description: Choose an age range to personalise the trip. The walkthrough uses a test selection, not a claim about the account holder.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Step 2 — trip length
description: Adjust the trip length slider between 1 and 14 days. This walkthrough retains seven days.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Step 3 — travelling companions
description: Choose Solo, Couple, Family or Friends. This walkthrough selects Solo.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Step 4 — trip focus
description: Select one or more interests: Nature, Aboriginal Culture, Adventure or Relaxation. The walkthrough chooses Nature.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Step 5 — vehicle
description: Choose the vehicle type. This walkthrough selects 4x4 so the conditional off-road-confidence question is also captured; a standard-car trip skips that question.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Step 6 — budget
description: Choose Budget, Mid-range or Luxury. The walkthrough selects Mid-range.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Step 7 — accommodation type
description: Choose Camping, Motel/Cabin or Hotel. This walkthrough selects Motel/Cabin.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Step 8 — activity level
description: Choose Low, Medium or High physical activity. This walkthrough selects Medium.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Step 9 — region
description: Choose Top End, Red Centre or Full NT. Regional artwork illustrates each option. The walkthrough selects Top End.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Step 10 — off-road confidence (4x4 only)
description: This question appears for a 4x4 trip. Choose confidence in off-road driving. Selecting a standard car skips it and reduces the displayed total to 14 steps.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Step 11 — heat preference
description: Adjust comfort with heat using the slider. The selected sentence describes the value rather than a percentage; this is a preference, not a weather forecast.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Step 12 — camping versus comfort
description: Choose Camping all the way, Bit of both or Resort comfort. This walkthrough selects Bit of both.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Step 13 — wildlife interest
description: Choose interest in wildlife experiences. This walkthrough selects Interested.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Step 14 — connectivity preference
description: Choose comfort with remote areas and limited phone signal. The preference informs planning; it does not measure coverage or internet speed.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Step 15 — start and end
description: Choose starting and ending locations before generating the route. This screenshot shows the unselected endpoint fields.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Start-location menu
description: Open the Start dropdown to see supported starting locations: Darwin, Jabiru, Katherine, Alice Springs and Uluru.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: End-location menu
description: Open the End dropdown. Choose the end location independently of the start; the walkthrough uses Katherine.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Ready to generate
description: All questions are answered and the trip endpoints are Darwin and Katherine. Generate My Route submits the preferences to the authenticated planner.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Generating the itinerary
description: The app sends the selected preferences to the authenticated planning backend. The loading screen shows trip context, progress copy and Cancel.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Itinerary — generated overview
description: A real online generation completed for the seven-day Darwin-to-Katherine 4x4 test trip. The result shows five stops, map pins, the sheet and route actions.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Itinerary — detailed schedule
description: Select Detailed to replace highlights with timed activities for each stop. The displayed activities come from the generated test itinerary.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Itinerary — expanded sheet
description: Expand Trip stops to make more of the itinerary list visible while retaining the map behind it. The sheet also supports a collapsed state.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Stop details — Darwin
description: Tap a stop card to open its image, timed plan, tags, display hours/fees, next leg, road-condition link and Skip/Navigate actions. Generated display facts are not verified live opening or access status.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Stop details — practical information
description: Scroll the stop detail to inspect hours, fee, next active stop, the official road-condition action and the generated explanatory note.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Itinerary — skipped stop
description: Choose Skip on the Darwin detail screen. The route returns with Darwin visibly marked Skipped; the change is session-only and can be reversed.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Stop details — unskip
description: Reopen a skipped stop. Its primary route-state action is now Unskip. The walkthrough restores the stop after this capture.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Itinerary — edit mode
description: Select Edit Route to expose stop reordering and per-stop remove controls. Done exits editing. These changes affect the active session route.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Itinerary — restore a removed stop
description: Remove a stop from the active test route. The count and pin numbering update, and Restore 1 removed stop provides a reversible recovery. No saved route was deleted.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Trip insights without imported data
description: From an itinerary, tap Trip insights. Review public source links, refill preferences and the explicit no-data state.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Import a prepared dataset
description: Tap Import JSON. Paste a version 1.0 dataset, then validate and import; invalid packages preserve the existing session data.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Demo preview enabled
description: Tap Preview demo. The visible banner explicitly identifies fictional places, prices and ratings; scroll down for the comparison cards.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Demo fuel savings comparison
description: Scroll below preferences to view diesel at $1.85/L compared with $2.15/L, giving a fictional $12 saving on 40 litres before detour costs.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Demo connectivity preparation
description: Continue scrolling to view the fictional Telstra coverage preparation example beneath the fuel comparison.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Demo accommodation score
description: Continue scrolling to view the fictional accommodation card, showing a synthetic 4.4/5 score from 286 reviews and no live room inventory.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Demo roadhouse facilities
description: Scroll to the bottom of demo insights to see the fictional combined rest stop, diesel, food and toilet facilities.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Saved routes
description: Open Saved Routes to see the latest generated itinerary alongside existing example routes.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Saved route actions
description: Tap the options button beside a route to rename, reorder or delete it. No saved route was deleted during this walkthrough.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Rename a saved route
description: Choose Rename to edit the title. This capture was followed by Cancel, preserving the existing name.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Profile in the default light appearance
description: Open Profile to review language, Light appearance, crash reporting disclosure, offline map explanation and account actions.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Appearance options
description: Tap the current appearance to view Dark, Light and System choices. Light remains the app default.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Optional dark appearance
description: Select Dark to preview the existing alternate appearance. Light was restored after this screenshot.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Collected historical data loaded
description: Open a saved itinerary, tap Trip insights, then View collected records. The banner states fuel is from December 2024 and accommodation listings from 2020.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5

title: Historical fuel record and source
description: Scroll below preferences to a collected fuel record. Its December 2024 validity interval, attribution, source link and expired status remain visible; no current savings claim is shown.
source: Existing Terra NT app; iPhone 17 Pro simulator; iOS 26.5
